description.value: Once per round, a paleberry king may make a melee attack with its knife. If a creature is struck by it, it must make a Fortitude save (DC 23) or it is reduced to -1 hp, stabilized and unconscious. Those who are immune to critical hits are immune to this and take the knife damage only. The knife is only deadly in the hands of a paleberry king, who has finesse training with it.

effect: Once per round after a knife hit; immune to critical hits takes only knife damage. Failure: stable, unconscious at -1 HP.

description.value: 5/day, as long as the paleberry king is not making a knife attack, it may use its Everyone's Grudge ability on a single target within 60 ft. The target takes 14d8 points of 'holy' damage (Fortitude save DC 22 for half damage). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 27).

effect: Cannot combine with a knife attack. Does not spend the separate retaliation.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 27).

description.value: There is a 10% chance when a paleberry king takes damage from an attack action or spell made by a foe, it gains an additional use of Everyone's Grudge that it may use as a free action against the character that damaged it. This extra use can only be made against its assailant and only on the round the paleberry king received damage. This ability does activate on damage suffered from sneak attacks and attacks of opportunity. This ability can be used a number of times per round equal to its Dexterity bonus and it also increases the damage by 1 each time it is used. It cannot use this ability on the same opponent twice per round.

effect: 01-10 after enemy attack/spell damage, including AoOs/sneak attack. Free Grudge against assailant this round; once per foe; max Dexterity modifier/round.

save.description: Half retaliation damage on a successful save.

effect: Free retaliation after a successful Karma chance. Target the assailant; the round bonus and per-foe limit are tracked separately from daily Grudge.
Reset only in untracked play. A started encounter tracks each round automatically.
